title: Easter splashes
description: This changes the minecraft splashes to be more Easter styled.
body:
# Easter Splashes
Bring some springtime cheer to your Minecraft title screen!
This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft splashes with Easter‑themed messages, adding a fun, colorful, and festive vibe every time you launch the game.

### Why download it?

- **Festive Easter Atmosphere:** Enjoy cheerful, egg‑themed, bunny‑themed, and spring‑inspired splashes.
- **Perfect for Seasonal Play:** Great for Easter events, themed servers, or just getting into the spring spirit.
- **Fun & Lighthearted:** Adds charm without changing any gameplay or textures.
- **Lightweight & Compatible:** Works with all other resource packs and shaders since it only edits splashes.

Hop into Minecraft with holiday cheer!

## Terms of Use

- You are free to use this resource pack in **Minecraft**, your **videos**, and your **modpacks**.
- If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you **add a link to this page in the description.**
 
_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
